It gives raktavarṇaḥ as his color.
It places him padmāsanasthaḥ and calls him bhūṣodevaḥ.
inference: The verse presents a specific red-colored, lotus-seated, ornamented form of Ganesha for welfare.
uncertainties: The fused first token contains multiple attributes in one compound.
